definition: Vendavo provides pricing, quoting and margin software for business-to-business sales.
example: A team checks whether a proposed discount meets its margin target.

definition: Vendor management oversees supplier selection, performance and relationships.
example: A buyer reviews supplier delivery and quality records.

definition: Vendor payments are the verification, authorization and settlement of amounts owed to suppliers.
example: An accounts-payable clerk matches an invoice to a purchase order before payment.

definition: Ventilator management is clinical oversight of mechanical breathing support and the patient’s response.
example: A respiratory care team reviews whether a patient is ready for less support.

definition: Verbal and physical intervention combines communication to de-escalate situations with authorized physical measures when needed for safety.
example: A trained care worker uses calm communication to de-escalate a tense interaction.
sense_note: Scope depends on training, setting and authorization.

definition: Version control records changes to files so contributors can compare, recover and combine revisions.
example: A developer identifies the change that introduced a bug.

definition: Vestibular rehabilitation uses therapy to improve function affected by dizziness or balance disorders.
example: A therapist tracks whether treatment improves a patient’s ability to walk while turning their head.

definition: Video advertising uses paid video placements to deliver promotional messages.
example: A nonprofit sponsors a short event announcement.

definition: Video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery is chest surgery performed through small incisions with a video camera.
example: A thoracic surgical team uses a camera to view an area of lung.

definition: Video.js is a web video player library that provides a customizable browser playback interface.
example: A publisher displays an interview with captions.

definition: Video marketing uses video content to communicate with audiences and pursue marketing goals.
example: A software company publishes a product walkthrough.

definition: Video remote interpreting connects an interpreter and participants through video.
example: A remote interpreter helps a patient communicate during a clinic visit.

definition: Videoconferencing connects people in different locations through live audio and video.
example: A distributed design team reviews a prototype on a call.

definition: Virtual design and construction uses digital models and coordinated workflows to plan and deliver built projects.
example: A team identifies intersections between pipes and beams in a shared model.

definition: Virtual production combines digital environments or effects with live production workflows.
example: A director frames actors against a digital backdrop on an LED wall.

definition: Virus culture refers to growing viruses in living host systems in controlled settings.
example: A virology team distinguishes evidence of infectious virus from a test that detects only genetic material.

definition: VISI is a CAD and CAM software suite used in manufacturing workflows such as mold and die design and machining.
example: A tool designer models a mold component before manufacturing it.

definition: VisiCalc was an early electronic spreadsheet for entering and calculating data in rows and columns.
example: A planner changes an estimate and sees the revised budget totals.

definition: Visier provides workforce analytics tools for examining employee and staffing data.
example: An analyst compares turnover across departments.

definition: Vision rehabilitation helps people with vision loss use strategies, tools and environmental adaptations to perform everyday activities.
example: A specialist helps a reader choose magnification and adjust task lighting.

definition: Visme is a design platform for creating presentations, infographics and other visual content.
example: A communications team makes an infographic from an annual report.

definition: VisSim is a block-diagram simulation tool for modeling dynamic systems.
example: An engineer studies how a modeled controller responds to a changing input.
sense_note: This is the VisSim simulation tool, not PTV Vissim traffic modeling.

definition: Visual odometry estimates a camera’s motion from successive images.
example: A robot estimates motion by following image features across frames.

definition: Visual storytelling uses imagery and sequence to communicate events, relationships or a point of view.
example: A film shows a character’s isolation through progressively wider shots.

definition: VMware Aria Automation Orchestrator builds workflows that automate actions across connected systems.
example: An administrator automates steps for an approved virtual machine request.

definition: VMware Aria Automation automates the delivery and management of cloud infrastructure and applications.
example: An infrastructure team publishes a virtual machine template for developers to request.

definition: VMware Aria Operations for Logs aggregates and analyzes log data for monitoring and troubleshooting.
example: An operator compares error messages from several hosts during an outage.

definition: VMware Aria Operations monitors infrastructure and workload performance, capacity and health.
example: An administrator checks which cluster is approaching its capacity limit.

definition: VMware Aria Suite bundles tools for cloud infrastructure operations and automation.
example: A team coordinates infrastructure provisioning with capacity tracking.

definition: Vocational rehabilitation counseling helps people with disabilities pursue employment goals and locate relevant supports.
example: A counselor helps a job seeker consider training and workplace accommodations.

definition: Voice UI design defines how users interact with systems through spoken input and responses.
example: A designer adds a clarifying question for ambiguous spoken commands.

definition: VPython supports the creation of interactive three-dimensional visualizations with Python.
example: An instructor visualizes a planet’s motion in a simulated orbit.

definition: Vue.js is a JavaScript framework for building reactive, component-based interfaces.
example: A Vue component updates a displayed list when its data changes.

definition: Vulkan is a cross-platform API for explicit control of graphics and compute work on compatible hardware.
example: A renderer submits drawing commands to a GPU using Vulkan.

definition: Vulnerability assessment identifies and prioritizes weaknesses in authorized systems according to risk.
example: A security team checks component inventories to prioritize patching.

definition: Vyond is a platform for making animated videos with configurable characters, scenes and media assets.
example: A training team creates an animated orientation video.

definition: Wainscot panelling covers the lower part of a wall with a protective or decorative finish.
example: A carpenter fits panels below the rail in a hallway.

definition: WASAPI is the Windows Audio Session API for accessing playback and capture audio streams.
example: An audio program sends sound to a selected endpoint.

definition: Waste characterisation describes waste by attributes such as composition, amount and hazardous properties.
example: A recycler estimates the share of recyclable packaging in a waste stream.

definition: Waste minimisation reduces the quantity or harmfulness of waste generated.
example: A workshop changes its cutting layout to produce fewer offcuts.
